name: Garments of Spirituality
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You be ready for your first test, adventurer. South of Razor Hill, just outta town, one of our grunts be hurt fightin' off some o' Proudmoore's old troops. She not doin' too well, an' she benefit much if one of our kind could help her. Find her--her name be Kor'ja--heal her wounds, an' give her the blessin' of our ancestors.

You do this, an' me thinks that be sufficient proof that you ready to move on in our ways.
narrative.objectives: Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Good, then Kor'ja lives and goes off to defend our town from those malicious humans. I often wish to remember days of battle; where power was shown in combat and it was the wise who often destroyed those who relied on just their strength.

You done good by me, adventurer. You take this robe now. Maybe it help, maybe you not care, but you earned it and I'm proud to call you brother.
narrative.requestItemsText: Most think it logical that healin' magics be powerful, but not many understand how powerful. You can keep many alive when instead they should be meetin' their own ancestors. This healin' magic mixed with the ability of Fortitude are a very powerful combination of spells. You remember this. It helpful to all manner of people: warriors, mages and everything in between.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 4, 360 XP in all.
